elements.title: The resulting output will look like this:

values.Value: Fluctuates between about 40,000 and 70,000 with seasonal peaks roughly every 12 units
values.Trend: Starts near 55,000, declines steadily to about 37,000 around index 50, then slightly rises
values.Season: Repeating seasonal pattern oscillating between -10,000 and 10,000 roughly every 12 units
values.Resid: Scatter of residuals centered around zero, mostly within ±5,000, with some outliers

elements.summary: This figure shows the decomposition of a time series into four components: the original values, the trend, the seasonal variation, and the residual noise, each plotted separately to illustrate their behavior over time.
